about: Requests for an add-on in casual words, to write the lines of understanding.md for the add-on writer from (claw/codeplan.py read). Written on 2026-11-19 before anything was run on them. Each expected piece: kind key or event; for a key its gesture as NVDA writes it; for an event its event, the kind of control (NVDA's Role) or null, and the state or null (! before it: the state is gone, as unchecked); body: beep, say:<the fixed words>, or model (the model writes the lines).
